body:
Elliot Price: Hey folks — kicking off docs planning for Usage Insights (cost drivers by route). Need to lock (1) where this lives in docs IA, (2) screenshots we need from console, (3) FAQ topics (esp invoice mismatch + exports). @Paula Mendes @Tessa Morgan @Felix Schneider @Wei Chen

Paula Mendes: thx. For IA: I was thinking under Console -> Observability? But it’s also cost/usage. We need something discoverable for FinOps folks.

Wei Chen: +1. Current IA has:
- Guides -> "Monitoring & Debugging"
- Console -> "Usage" (today it’s mostly token usage + invoices)
Maybe new section: Console -> "Usage Insights" and then cross-link from "Monitoring".

Tessa Morgan: Design spec assumes it’s a first-class Console nav item under Usage, not under Observability. It’s about spend attribution first, perf second.

Felix Schneider: from implementation, in Console left nav it’s Usage -> "Insights". So docs should probably match: Console docs > Usage > Usage Insights.

Elliot Price: ok, proposal:
1) Docs landing page: "Usage Insights" under Console > Usage.
2) Subpages:
   a) Overview (what it is, how it differs from invoices)
   b) Setup: Route identifiers (how to set route + naming rules)
   c) Using the dashboard (filters, route list, route detail, deltas)
   d) Export reports (CSV/JSON, limits, audit logging)
Plus: a short “Troubleshooting” section, maybe on Export page.

Paula Mendes: looks good. Can we keep “Setup: Route identifiers” close to top? This is the action required to avoid Unknown route.

Wei Chen: yep. Also suggest we add a callout on Overview: “You’ll see best results after tagging routes; otherwise traffic is grouped as Unknown route.”

Dev Patel: please include a “why does it not match my invoice” FAQ. This will generate tickets.

Elliot Price: screenshot needs — can someone confirm which views are stable enough?
- route list table (top spend + sparkline)
- route detail view w model breakdown
- export modal / export created toast
- empty state (no data / missing route tags)
- error state (export too large?)

Felix Schneider: route list + detail are basically stable behind `usage_insights` flag. Export modal is in progress but should be ready by end of week. Error state: we have a “time range too large” inline error and a “max rows exceeded” for export job.

Dylan Brooks: we can get you staging screenshots once UI merges. We should capture both light and dark mode? (docs usually light only)

Elliot Price: light mode is fine unless design wants both.

Tessa Morgan: light mode only. But please capture one with filters expanded; the filter model is non-obvious (env/region/deployment mode + compare to prior period).

Wei Chen: also need screenshots for route naming guidance? Like where route appears in UI? Maybe a small highlight/circle.

Felix Schneider: I can add some mock highlights but usually docs team does that. I’ll provide clean screenshots.

Paula Mendes: FAQ topics I think we need:
- Why doesn’t route total match invoice total?
- Why do I see “Unknown route” / “Other routes” buckets?
- How fresh is the data? (near-real-time vs late events)
- What happens with model fallback (smart routing)?
- Can I export weekly automatically? (answer: not yet; workaround)
- Does export respect RBAC and is it audit logged?
- Limits: time ranges, max rows, CSV schema versioning

Dev Patel: add: “I changed route names and now trends look broken” (naming stability + cardinality best practices). Also: “Why are some routes missing model breakdown columns?” (if model unknown or old data?)

Wei Chen: On the mismatch question, we should be careful with wording: “Usage Insights is for operational attribution and may differ from billing exports due to timing, retention, discounts/credits, and rounding.”

Paula Mendes: yes and mention: invoices include credits/adjustments; console insights shows metered usage at request level.

Elliot Price: for exports page, we should include the exact CSV columns? Or link to schema reference.

Felix Schneider: export will have both CSV + JSON. CSV columns: `timestamp_bucket`, `org_id`, `project_id`, `environment`, `region`, `deployment_mode`, `route`, `model`, `input_tokens`, `output_tokens`, `cached_tokens`, `total_cost_usd`, `p50_latency_ms`, `p95_latency_ms`, `error_rate` (some may be blank depending on view). Might evolve.

Wei Chen: we should avoid hard-coding if it’s changing. Maybe list “core fields” and add a note “may add columns over time; existing columns won’t be removed w/o notice” (assuming that’s the plan).

Paula Mendes: plan is additive only. If we add columns, we’ll version the schema in docs + release notes. We can put `schema_version` in JSON export at least.

Elliot Price: perfect. I’ll write exports doc as:
- “What you get” (CSV + JSON)
- “How to export” steps
- Limits (max time range / max rows / retention)
- Audit logging + RBAC statement
- Schema (core fields + link to a reference table)

Tessa Morgan: on screenshots, please also include the “What changed vs prior period” delta UI on route detail. That’s one of the main value props.

Felix Schneider: noted.

Dylan Brooks: timeline: UI should be in staging by Tue. I’ll ping you with a staging org + feature flag instructions.

Elliot Price: great. Also: where do we want setup instructions for SDK tagging? Is that a separate page under “SDKs” or this doc?

Monica Patel: from DevEx side we prefer this doc links out to SDK reference pages (Python/TS/Go) with snippets. But we can include minimal snippets inline too.

Wei Chen: propose minimal inline snippet for each SDK + link out to full SDK docs. People shouldn’t have to hunt.

Paula Mendes: +1. Also include gateway-derived route option for folks who can’t touch app code right away.

Elliot Price: ok. Action items:
- @Felix Schneider / @Dylan Brooks: deliver 5 screenshots (route list, filters expanded, route detail w deltas, model breakdown, export modal + an error/limit state) by Tue/Wed.
- @Paula Mendes: confirm final IA + naming for pages (Usage -> Insights vs Usage Insights).
- @Wei Chen: draft FAQ bullets + suggested phrasing on invoice mismatch + freshness.
- @Dev Patel: send top 5 anticipated support questions + any preferred language.

Dev Patel: will do. I’ll also pull examples from recent tickets (Unknown route dominating, export timeouts).

Tessa Morgan: I’ll drop a note about which empty states we expect (no data vs missing route tagging) so docs doesn’t screenshot an old placeholder.

Wei Chen: for IA naming, “Usage Insights” is clearer than “Insights” in docs nav. In Console it can be “Insights” but H1 can be “Usage Insights”.

Paula Mendes: agree. In docs: “Usage Insights”; in app: “Insights”.

Elliot Price: sounds good. I’ll start a draft in `redwood-docs` and tag y’all for review once screenshots land.
